title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the pipeline's schemas: ids, dates, evidence and the dated interval {from, to, evidence}.

date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (a real date).

datetime.description: An ISO 8601 datetime with its offset (UTC preferred, Z).

date_or_datetime.description: A date, or a datetime when known (DATA-PIPELINE §5.1: datetimes when known).

capture_id.description: A capture id of the source: W<n> (Wayback), G<n> (commit), S<n> (our saved fetch).

model_key.description: A models.json key (today's raw-data.csv model spelling).

publisher_id.description: A publishers.json id: today's catalog publisher spelling (the value of data/catalog/publishers.json, or the raw-data.csv source itself when not merged), so lqm.load's maps resolve as today. Spaces and parentheses are allowed (23 Oct 2026) because two raw-data.csv sources carry them ('EQ-bench/eqbench-leaderboard-results (GitHub)', 'epoch.ai (vals.ai ProofBench v1.0-era)'); a source id writes its publisher slug lowercased, with '/', spaces and parentheses as '_'.

source_id.description: A source snapshot id: src-<publisher slug>-<what>-<YYYY-MM-DD> (lowercase; '/' of a publisher id written '_').

setup_id.description: A benchmarks.json setup id (today's group name where it exists).

fact_ref.description: A fact of the measure's source: a fact id (F<n>), or a table cell T<n>/<row key>/<column> (table id before the first '/', column after the last '/', row key in between).

evidence.description: One piece of evidence: a document (url) or a findings fact (source + fact), with a locator.

url.description: Page or document URL (the live URL or a Wayback capture URL).

captured.description: When this copy was captured (Wayback timestamp or our fetch).

file.description: Saved copy (path in the salvo folders; outside git).

where.description: Locator inside the document: page, section, line, JSON path, table cell.

source.description: A findings source that holds the fact (instead of a URL).

fact.description: The fact id in that source.

note.description: Anything the reader needs (why this evidence dates the interval...).

evidence_list.description: Evidence for a registry statement (at least one).

interval.description: A dated interval {from, to, evidence} (DATA-PIPELINE §4): from = the effective date the document states, else its earliest capture (configurations served as themselves: the release); to = the change it states, else the last capture still showing it. Between two captures showing the same text the interval is covered; after the last one it is not; a single capture covers its own day only. A bound taken from a capture (from_basis earliest-capture, to_basis last-capture) is written as that capture's day (YYYY-MM-DD; a `to` date covers the whole day). to = null (no end known) is allowed only for configurations and names (release-dated, open); defaults, conversions, modes, route entries and prices always carry their last capture or stated change.

dated_configuration.description: A configuration in force over an interval (a default). `setting` splits a default in two when the maker documents the thinking default and the effort default separately (Anthropic Opus 4.5–4.8, Sonnet 4.6: a call with no thinking field is thinking off, the effort parameter defaults to high).

setting.description: Which part of a call with no setting the default covers (absent: the whole call). `thinking`: what a call with no thinking field gets (nothink = thinking off). `effort`: the level a call gets when it sends no effort level while thinking is on (a thinking-on fact, or a name selecting think). A call that sends neither gets the `thinking` default, the `effort` one only through thinking on; at most one default per setting at a time.
